articles.title_en: Ukrainian drones strike Russia’s Leningrad region, sparking fire at one of the country’s largest oil refineries
articles.lead_en: Ukrainian drones struck the Leningrad region overnight on November 9, and 113 of them were shot down, Governor Alexander Drozdenko said.

articles.title_en: Rosneft begins limiting fuel sales at gas stations in Russia
articles.lead_en: Rosneft has imposed fuel purchase limits at its gas stations across Russia, the Zabaykalsky Krai Economic Development Ministry said in a post on the Max messenger, adding that drivers can buy up to 30 liters (7.9 gallons) of fuel at city gas stations and up to 50 liters (13.2 gallons) on highways. The ministry did not provide further details.
